title: ‘Simulacrum of Stories’: Examining Large Language Models as Qualitative Research Participants
reasoning: The paper is an empirical investigation into the ethical and epistemological implications of using LLMs in qualitative research. It evaluates issues of consent, agency, and epistemic injustice as core components of the study, rather than just as a brief limitations section, drawing extensively on research ethics and Science and Technology Studies (STS) frameworks.
